install_flow: The bat runs `copy /b` to reassemble parts into New-Era-Setup.exe
The bat verifies SHA-256 via built-in certutil
New-Era-Setup.exe is launched: native 7-Zip SFX GUI installer
Installer shows Extract-To dialog defaulting to PMDO/MODS
User picks the destination (or accepts the default)
Completion dialog: 'Lancez PMDO -> Special Episodes -> New Era'

components_provenance.sfx_module_source: 7zSD.sfx from 7-Zip Extra (LGPL, Copyright 1999-2018 Igor Pavlov). Redistribution allowed per LGPL. Bundled via npm package '7zip-standalone' at build time; module SHA-256 preserved.
components_provenance.config_source: Generated at build time (config.txt with GUI directives).
components_provenance.archive_source: Mod content of the current repo tree, packaged via dev/tools/package_windows.py, compressed with py7zr LZMA2 preset 6.

content_note: Includes the 27 canonical PMD Red EU ROM-converted grounds (12 previously promoted dungeons + 15 newly promoted: d04p02, d12p02, d12p04, d13p02, d13p03, d14p01, d15p01, d16p01, d17p01, d18p01, d19p01, d20p01, d21p01, d23p01, d25p01), each validated in real PMDO 0.8.12 headless runtime (LOAD/MOVEMENT/ANIMATION PASS, verdict SAFE).
